scenes.title: 同级比较 as...as 的肯定句
scenes.lead: 表示两个东西一样，用 as + 原级 + as。
scenes.sentence: Tom is as tall as his brother.

scenes.title: 同级比较 as...as 的否定句
scenes.lead: 表示不如，用 not as + 原级 + as。
scenes.sentence: This book is not as interesting as that one.

scenes.title: 同级比较 as...as 的写作运用
scenes.lead: 写比喻或比较时，用 as...as 让句子更生动。
scenes.sentence: Her smile is as warm as the sun.
scenes.zh: 她的微笑像太阳一样温暖。
